🏅 Nobel Prizes, country by country — 1901 → 2025.

The United States has 431. The United Kingdom, second, has 113. It wasn't always so: Germany and France led the first decades. Watch the ranking tip after 1933, when Jewish and dissident scientists fled Nazi Germany — many of them to American universities, which never gave the lead back 🎓

📊 Data: Nobel Prize API, nobelprize.org (CC0). Each prize goes to the country of the laureate's institution at the time; organisations awarded the Peace Prize are excluded.
